name: freesave-write
description: FREESAVE, HALF ONE — doc 67 slate item G. Resume the overworld state on the switches-OFF build, press the fixture's L+R+A hook, and let it seed six values chosen for WHERE THEY LIVE in SaveBlock1 and then call the engine's own TrySavingData(SAVE_NORMAL). Its job is to leave a .sav on the host that the switches-ON build will later try to read. It asserts only that the hook ran and the save reported OK — every value it prints is an OBSERVATION whose job is to pin the expected numbers into freesave-read-control.json and freesave-read-flipped.json, because a number this run guessed at would be a claim about the fixture rather than about the engine.
symbols_from_why: gFreeSaveHookLatch and gFreeSaveOffsets are fork-only symbols.

probes.why: THE CLAIM of this half: the hook ran and TrySavingData returned SAVE_STATUS_OK. Latched, never cleared (doc 66).
CONTROL. gSaveFileStatus as this build's own boot left it — the baseline the flipped build's value is read against.
OBSERVATION. The seeded Zigzagoon's level at party+0x54 — outside the encrypted substructures (doc 55 §9).
OBSERVATION. SaveBlock1+0x490, BELOW the cut. Read RAW, not decrypted: the claim is about bytes surviving, and the XOR key lives in SaveBlock2, which is a different sector with a different fate.
OBSERVATION. The flags[] byte holding FLAG_SYS_POKEDEX_GET (0x861): 4720 + 2145/8. ABOVE the cut.
OBSERVATION. vars[] entry for VAR_RECYCLE_GOODS (0x4020): 5020 + 0x20*2. ABOVE the cut.
OBSERVATION. dexCaught byte 0 at SaveBlock1+13849 — past 11904, so THE TAIL, sector 4, the sector whose size the switches change.
OBSERVATION. SaveBlock2+0x0E — a different block, sector 0, whose size the switches also change.
CONTROL. The run stayed in the overworld across the save, i.e. TrySavingData did not drop it onto the save-failed screen.

assert.why: THE CLAIM. 3 == FREESAVE_LATCH_SEEDED | FREESAVE_LATCH_SAVED_OK. Exact and non-zero, so it discriminates under an address shift; the SAVED_FAIL bit would make this 5.
CONTROL. Positive symbol_at, not a negative one — doc 72 recorded that a negative symbol_at passes under an address shift because <unresolved> is not the thing being excluded.
